caption: I told myself the car would cost R4 000 a month. Would you have guessed R9 900 with everything?

slides.title:
What my first car
really costs me
on R22 800 p/m
Living in Barberton
slides.body:
Male, 27
Single, no kids
Job: Field ranger, private game reserve
Net salary: R22 800 p/m
Car: 2020 Suzuki Swift, bought four months ago

slides.title: Car instalment
slides.body: I told the dealer R3 500. The final figure was R4 200 once the extras were added.

slides.title: Car insurance & tracker
slides.body: I got three quotes. The cheapest was R300 less and had no tracker. I took the tracker.

slides.title: Petrol
slides.includes: Reserve gate to town and back, twice a week
slides.body: The reserve road is gravel for 22 km. My petrol bill knows it.

slides.title: Maintenance & tyres
slides.includes: Service plan, two tyres, a cracked windscreen
slides.body: The windscreen was a month in. A kudu did not cause it, a lorry did.

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Staff cottage, deducted by the reserve
slides.body: It's cheap because it's a cottage with a leaky roof. I am not complaining.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: groceries, black tax, prepaid electricity, funeral policy, stokvel, airtime, medical aid, takeaways
slides.body: Eight small lines, R8 100 together. The takeaways are R1 250 of it, mostly the town trips.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R22 800. Before the car I had about R8 000 left each month. Now I notice every R50.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and tagged the car costs together.

R9 900 was a long way from the R4 000 I'd told everyone.

No bank login needed.
